name: MakerWorks-v2
description: MakerWorks v2 is a self-hosted 3D model hub with STL previews, price estimation, optional Stripe checkout, and an admin dashboard for site settings, pricing, backups, and OrderWorks job monitoring. Point it at any reachable Postgres 15+ instance and map a persistent storage share for uploaded models, covers, avatars, and backups. On Unraid, this primary container also runs the image/preview processing worker by default so uploads use the same database and storage settings as the web app. Unraid note: "Autostart" starts the container when the array/Docker service starts, but crash recovery still depends on Docker restart policy. If the container stops, check its logs: the image startup sequence runs restore, Prisma migrations, admin bootstrap, then the Next.js server and integrated processing worker.

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Persistent backup destination (set BACKUP_DIR to this container path)

paths.description: Optional mapped folder used by the bulk upload script. Put source STL/OBJ/3MF/AMF/PLY/WRL/VRML/GLB/GLTF/USD/USDZ/USDA/USDC/ZIP files here and run the importer against /app/imports.

ports.name: Web Port

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Postgres connection string (must be reachable from the container)

variables.name: REDIS_URL
variables.description: Redis connection string used for BullMQ processing queues

variables.name: BASE_URL
variables.description: Public URL users access (used for redirects/cookies)

variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: Secret used to sign user sessions (set to a long random string)

variables.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: Email for the bootstrap administrator account

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the bootstrap administrator (rotated on change)

variables.name: ADMIN_NAME
variables.description: Display name for the bootstrap administrator account

variables.name: STORAGE_DIR
variables.description: Internal storage path (leave at /app/storage unless customizing)

variables.name: DIRECT_UPLOAD_URL
variables.description: Optional direct hostname (e.g., https://upload.example.com) used only for uploads to bypass Cloudflare/Tunnel size limits

variables.name: BULK_UPLOAD_DIR
variables.description: Default in-container folder scanned by the bulk upload importer

variables.name: BULK_UPLOAD_BASE_URL
variables.description: URL used by the bulk upload importer when run inside the container. Leave at http://127.0.0.1:3000 for Unraid.

variables.name: S3_BUCKET
variables.description: Optional S3 bucket (leave blank to store uploads locally on STORAGE_DIR)

variables.name: S3_REGION
variables.description: Region/endpoint for the S3 bucket (e.g., us-east-1)

variables.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.description: Access key for the configured S3-compatible storage

variables.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.description: Secret key for the configured S3-compatible storage

variables.name: COOKIE_SECURE
variables.description: Set to true when BASE_URL is HTTPS so auth cookies are secure

variables.name: SKIP_DOCKER

variables.name: BACKUP_DIR
variables.description: Backup destination inside the container. Must point to a mapped path (recommended: /app/backups).

variables.name: PG_DUMP_BIN
variables.description: Path to pg_dump binary used by backup when SKIP_DOCKER=1 (or docker compose path fails)

variables.name: PSQL_BIN
variables.description: Path to psql binary used by restore when SKIP_DOCKER=1 (or docker compose path fails)

variables.name: BACKUP_DOCKER_SERVICE
variables.description: Docker Compose DB service name used for pg_dump/psql when compose mode is enabled

variables.name: BACKUP_SCHEDULE_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable daily scheduled backups (1=true, 0=false)

variables.name: BACKUP_SCHEDULE_TIME_UTC
variables.description: Daily backup time in UTC (HH:mm)

variables.name: BACKUP_RUN_ON_START
variables.description: Run one backup when scheduler starts (1=true, 0=false)

variables.name: BACKUP_PRUNE_ON_BACKUP
variables.description: Prune old backups immediately after each successful backup

variables.name: BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: Keep backups newer than this many days (0 disables age-based retention)

variables.name: BACKUP_RETENTION_MAX_COUNT
variables.description: Always keep at least this many newest backups (0 disables count-based retention)

variables.name: PROCESSING_QUEUE_ATTEMPTS

variables.name: PROCESSING_QUEUE_BACKOFF_MS
variables.description: Exponential backoff delay (ms) between queue retries

variables.name: START_PROCESSING_WORKER
variables.description: Run the image/preview processor inside this MakerWorks container so it uses the same DATABASE_URL and STORAGE_DIR settings

variables.name: IMAGE_WORKER_CONCURRENCY

variables.name: PREVIEW_WORKER_CONCURRENCY
variables.description: Concurrency for preview processing inside this container

variables.name: PRINTER_PROFILE
